book.name: 1 Timoti
book.title: Balua ju ukutumbulii jaka Pauli kwaka Timoti

content: Hetupalika kutama na bandu baahobale
Wandakali mwanalomi nseja, ila gumpwagila ngati atati baku. Wapwagila akakombu ngati alongu baku,
na waapwagila aka mbomba aseja ngati akaamabaku, na aka kamwali ngati akaabeli baku, ku usapi woti.
Watendila isima aka mbomba bawii akalomi babu babube ngaseabii na bandu bakajangatila.

Lakini mmbomba joawii alomi jojubii na bana na asokoo, haba apalika kulibola kutimisa mahengu gabu gikidini kwa alongu babu beni nakalepa akahengo babu na ahoku babu, ndi heli lijambu luku mpalisa palongi jaka Sapanga.
Mmbomba joawii alomi sakaka, jwanga na mundu jukunzangati, ambeki Sapanga hobale laki nukuendale kunndoba Sapanga bunzangatiya ikilu na muhi.
Lakini mmbomba joawii alomi jojutama kukutokule kila sindu, hoju juwi hata ngati jakona mwomi.
Wapekia malagisu ganga, ili mundu jokapi jukotuka kwaalongale liya.
Lakini ana mundu ngasejaatunza alongu baki, hasa bukunyumba jaki, mundu hoju jwiikuba jukukaniki kuhobale kwaki na jwiikuba mmbaja ngani kupeta mundu jwanga kuhobale.
Wammbalangi mundu jokapi kuba ngati mundu joawii alomi baki ana ngase jujomwi yaka sitini. Kabee jubia juwaiki kujukulika malajimu pee,
na jubiya na mahengu gaamboni: Jojaatunziki banabaki sapi, jojaajopiki ageni kunyumba jaki, jojaajopa atumisi baka Sapanga, jojajangatiya bandu bana mang'aliku, na jojilipia kuhenga majambu gaamboni.
Kotuka kwaandika bandu baawii alomi akanabali, ndaba ana ndokule yabu ya nhyega ana ijonzukiki kuba na makili ngani kupeta kulipia kwabu kwaka Kilisitu, biipala kutoguleka kabee,
nabombi kwi indela heji biibonikana abii na makosa ngani ndaba jukulileka lilagi labu lu puuwanzu.

Aka mbomba bawii alomi ngati haba atumbuli kuhoa kipindi sabu suku jendajenda nyumba mbaki nyumba; kabee sindu siliyaa ngani atumbuli kwaalongale bandu liya, nukulijege mu majambu ga bandu bangi, koni bakapwaga majambu gaguge ngasebapalika kupwaga.
Henu mbala aka mbomba bawii akalomi akanabali atogulika, apata bana nukutunza nyumba yabu ili mbaja witu bipata napwasi kupwaga majambu giliya kati jitu.
Ndaba aka mbomba bawii akalomi bangi ahobiki nukulipwata Lijobi.

Lakini ana nyongo joanhobale Kilisitu jubii na aka mbomba bawii alomi mu nyumba jaki, jombi jupalika kwaatunza na nga kulileke likundi la bandu babuhobale Kilisitu nsigu hogu, ili likundi la bandu babuhobale Kilisitu liwesa kwaatunza aka mbomba bawii alome bala bahigali kajika jabu pena.
Aka kilongosi bi likundi la bandu babuhobale Kilisitu babalongosa bandu sapi apalika kupata isima ngamaa, hasa bandu baalandi nukubola bandu.
Ndaba Maandiku ga Sapi gapwaga, “Gwiinkonga ng'ombi punndomu paujitumi lihengu lukuhusa ilebi,” naka bee, “Jojuhenga lihengu jupalika malipu gaki.”
Wijetake kujopa mataki gabaataki aseja ana ngasegaletiki bandu abeli au atatu baaboniki nu kujoana.
Bandu baatenda mahakau waalakalia pangwendu, ili bangi ajogapa.

Nugulagalaki palongi jaka Sapanga, na palongi jaka Kilisitu Yesu na palongi ja atumi buku nani kwaka Sapanga ba Sapi, ugakamulakia malagalaki ganga bila kulileka hatalimu, wala kumpendale mundu jokapi mu kila segutenda.
Mwijombatee kumbeke mundu jokapi maboku ndaba jukunndobe. Wiihangani mahakau ga bangi; ulibeka mu sapi.
Wiikunywa masi pena, ila gukunywa na divai kasokopi ndaba ji litumbu laku, ndaba gulwala mala kwa mala.
Mahakau ga bandu bangi gabonikana pangwendu, yombi yaalongule mukutemuliwa; lakini mahakau ga bangi gabonikana pe monikatae.
Ahelahe, mahengu gaamboni gabonikana pangwendu, na hata mahengu gangakubonikana pangwendu ngasegawesa kuhihika.
